payload.tension: The passage states ephesians 2:16–22 names God’s Spirit within a source unit where the Spirit is locally described; the wording centers attention on “Through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
